name: Twista
bio: Chicago rapper renowned for rapid-fire delivery, intricate rhythmic patterns, and technical precision.

name: Tech N9ne
bio: Kansas City independent rap icon known for technical precision, rapid flows, theatrical delivery, and a remarkably sustained career.

name: Busta Rhymes
bio: New York rap veteran celebrated for explosive delivery, animated performances, distinctive flows, and technical versatility.

name: Eminem
bio: Detroit rapper recognized for complex rhyme schemes, technical lyricism, storytelling, character work, and massive global influence.

name: Young Thug
bio: Atlanta artist whose elastic vocals, unconventional melodies, flows, and stylistic experimentation helped reshape modern trap music.

name: Drake
bio: Toronto rapper and singer known for combining rap, melody, introspection, and pop instincts across a highly successful career.

name: Lil Wayne
bio: New Orleans rap icon known for punchlines, metaphors, freestyle-oriented writing, mixtape dominance, and enormous influence on later generations.

name: Jay-Z
bio: Brooklyn rap legend known for layered lyricism, effortless flows, sharp wordplay, entrepreneurial influence, and exceptional longevity.

name: The Game
bio: Compton rapper known for vivid West Coast imagery, aggressive delivery, detailed references, and a long-running catalog.

name: Kendrick Lamar
bio: Compton rapper acclaimed for conceptual albums, dense lyricism, character-driven storytelling, vocal experimentation, and cultural impact.

name: Ludacris
bio: Atlanta rap veteran known for animated flows, comedic wordplay, memorable punchlines, charisma, and high-energy delivery.

name: J. Cole
bio: North Carolina rapper and producer known for introspective writing, grounded storytelling, technical rapping, and self-produced records.

name: Fabolous
bio: Brooklyn rapper respected for slick punchlines, double meanings, effortless delivery, mixtape work, and longevity.

name: Jadakiss
bio: Yonkers rapper renowned for his unmistakable voice, punchlines, street lyricism, consistency, and commanding presence.

name: André 3000
bio: Atlanta artist and Outkast member celebrated for imaginative writing, unconventional flows, musical experimentation, and enduring influence.

name: T.I.
bio: Atlanta rapper and trap pioneer known for confident delivery, Southern storytelling, crossover records, and influence on trap's mainstream rise.
